reference: F. Najman, Torsion of elliptic curves over number fields of degree 6, 7, 8 and 9 (2026), in preparation
notes: The unique elliptic curve over an octic field with a subgroup Z/3 x Z/15, up to isomorphism of the pair (K,E). K = Q(zeta_3)(w) with w^4-5w^3+8w^2-6w+3 = 0 (LMFDB 8.0.2313441.1), E: y^2 + a1*x*y + a3*y = x^3 with j = 1331/8, P = (0,0) of order 3 and Q of order 15 with primitive Weil pairing e_3(P,5Q); relative degree 4 over Q(zeta_3). The full torsion is C3 x C15: at a prime above 7 of residue degree 2 the reduction has the group Z/3 x Z/15. The curve is a twist of 338.d2 but not the base change of an elliptic curve over Q or Q(zeta_3).
